businessProblem: Fortis Healthcare Ltd. faces an acute governance credibility crisis as of February 28, 2018. Active allegations of promoter-linked fund diversion through inter-corporate deposits have severely damaged investor, lender, and regulatory confidence in the company. The board's independence and oversight capability are under scrutiny. The company has underlying capital needs that cannot be addressed through normal market access while governance allegations remain unresolved. Potential strategic investors exist but will not proceed without governance clarity. The healthcare business context amplifies the commercial risk: patient trust, clinical talent retention, and regulatory relationships are all commercially sensitive to governance reputation. The core problem is not an operating performance failure but a governance and ownership integrity crisis that, if unresolved, will destroy value in an otherwise valuable hospital network. Governance reset must precede any capital or strategic transaction.

evidence.finding: Active allegations of promoter-linked fund diversion through inter-corporate deposits; allegations are unresolved and not adjudicated as of the decision date
Board independence and oversight credibility are under scrutiny given the nature and scale of governance allegations against promoter-linked entities
Company has capital needs that are difficult to address through normal market access while governance allegations remain active and unresolved
Investor and lender confidence is severely impaired by governance allegations; institutional shareholders and creditors are in a state of heightened concern
Potential strategic investors are aware of the company's hospital network value but governance clarity is a stated prerequisite for any credible transaction process
Hospital and clinical operations continue but face reputational risk; in healthcare, governance failure can damage patient trust, clinical staff retention, and regulatory relationships
Regulatory attention is active; authorities are monitoring governance allegations and related-party transaction disclosures
Underlying hospital network has real asset value in Indian healthcare market; governance crisis is creating a value discount that will persist without resolution
